header.label: Name and contact
header.example: Name · city · phone · email · LinkedIn. No photo, no date of birth.

summary.label: 3-line objective
summary.example: Who you are now · your best proof · the domain you want

education.label: Education + ICITSS row
education.example: Newest first. Remarks never blank. ICITSS sits in this table.

experience.label: Work experience
experience.example: Intern, [Firm], Indore: vouched 120 purchase bills against goods receipt notes

projects.label: Projects
projects.example: Read [Listed company]'s annual report; summarised its 3 key audit matters

certifications.label: Certifications and job simulations
certifications.example: Statutory audit Work Simulation, MSC Articleship Program | [Month Year]: vouched [N] purchase bills

leadership.label: Roles and achievements
leadership.example: Treasurer, Commerce Society 2024–25: kept the accounts of 9 events

skills.label: Skills
skills.example: Excel: XLOOKUP, PivotTables, SUMIFS · Tally Prime: GST vouchers

interests.label: Interests
interests.example: One or two you can talk about for a minute

A.name: Academics
A.useIf: First attempt, an exemption, a rank or strong school marks, and little else yet.
A.reason: Your marks are your loudest proof, so they sit on top with every Remark filled.
A.rule: No Remarks cell is blank, and every remark is something a mark sheet or certificate shows.

examples.education: CA Intermediate (both groups) | [Year] | ICAI | [Marks] | First attempt; [best paper score]

B.name: Groups separately
B.useIf: Your Inter groups came in different sittings, or a level took more than one attempt.
B.reason: Your Inter took more than one sitting. Show each result clearly and put your proof of improvement right under the table.
B.rule: Each group gets its own row with its own year and marks. A year-only column is fine.

examples.education: CA Inter Group II | [Year] | [Marks], then Group I | [Year] | [Marks]

C.name: Work experience
C.useIf: An internship, your family business's books, tuition or part-time accounts work.
C.reason: Real work beats everything at your stage. It goes right after your education.
C.rule: Say what the organisation is, then two to four action lines with numbers. Never a client's name.

D.name: Projects
D.useIf: Work Simulation levels, a job simulation, a model, a dashboard or an annual-report project.
D.reason: Your projects show you can already do the work. They go right after your education.
D.rule: Simulations go in Certifications and job simulations, your own projects in Projects, neither in Experience.

E.name: Extra-curriculars
E.useIf: Posts you held, sport, debate, NCC or volunteering are your strongest proof.
E.reason: Your roles show you can own a task and handle people. They go right after your education.
E.rule: Role + scale + result + year in every line. Recent and relevant first.

examples.leadership: Captain, college cricket team 2024–25: led 15 players to the inter-college semi-final

F.name: Skills with proof
F.useIf: Excel, Tally Prime, Power BI or a portal you have actually used.
F.reason: Your skills are your edge. Name the functions and put the proof next to each.
F.rule: Name the functions or tasks, put the proof beside them, and expect to show it live.

examples.skills: Excel (proficient): XLOOKUP, PivotTables, SUMIFS; built a debtors-ageing sheet of 400 entries

G.name: Direct entry
G.useIf: You joined after graduation, so there is no Foundation row.
G.reason: No Foundation row for you. Your graduation row carries the Remarks.
G.rule: The graduation row carries the Remarks; nothing to explain about the missing row.

examples.education: B.Com (Hons) | [Year] | [University] | 8.1 CGPA | First class. No Foundation row.

H.name: Nothing yet
H.useIf: Nothing on your CV yet beyond your marks.
H.reason: One weekend gives you four certificates and a project line.
H.rule: Build it in this order: objective, education with ICITSS, the four quick certificates, the MSC line, extra-curriculars.

examples.education: Class X, XII, CA Foundation, CA Inter, B.Com if any. ICITSS row inside.
examples.certifications: The four quick certificates + the MSC Articleship Program line

g2-awaited.label: One group awaited
lines: CA Intermediate [Group II] | [Year] | ICAI | Result awaited
g2-awaited.ask: My [Group II] result is due on [date]. I'll share it the day it is out.

result-awaited.label: Result awaited
lines: CA Intermediate (both groups) | [Year] | ICAI | Result awaited
result-awaited.ask: My result is due on [date]. I'll share it the day it is out.

groups-separately.label: Groups in different sittings
groups-separately.note: Each group its own row, newest first.
groups-separately.ask: I cleared Group I in [Month Year] and Group II in [Month Year].

more-attempts.label: More than one attempt
more-attempts.note: A year-only column is fine. Put your best paper in Remarks.
lines: CA Intermediate (both groups) | [Year] | ICAI | [Marks] | [Best paper score]
more-attempts.ask: I cleared it in my [second] attempt. What changed: [one true line].

gap.label: A gap
gap.note: Never hide it: the years in your table show it anyway. Real work in the gap goes in Work experience. If there was none, no CV line, but keep one true sentence ready.
gap.ask: [Month Year] to [Month Year] I [true reason]. Since then I have [what you completed].

asks.missed-sitting: I skipped the [Month Year] sitting because [true reason]. I cleared [the group] in [Month Year].

icitss-ongoing.label: ICITSS ongoing
lines: ICITSS (Orientation Course + IT Training) | ICAI | Ongoing, completes [Month Year]
icitss-ongoing.ask: I complete ICITSS on [date], so I can join from [date].

icitss-pending.label: ICITSS not started
icitss-pending.note: Book your batch now: articleship starts only after ICITSS.
lines: ICITSS (Orientation Course + IT Training) | ICAI | Batch from [Month Year]
icitss-pending.ask: My ICITSS batch starts on [date], so I can join from [date].

distance.label: Distance or evening B.Com
distance.ask: My exams are in [months]. I'll plan my leave for them well in advance.

stopped.label: Degree stopped
stopped.note: Leave it out unless it explains a gap. Never write Pursuing.
stopped.ask: I stopped B.Com after [Year N] to focus on CA.

cs-cma.label: CA with {course}
cs-cma.note: Same education table. Give your true reason, never a borrowed one.
cs-cma.ask: CA comes first. I take {course} papers only where they don't clash.

cfa.line: CFA Level I | CFA Institute | Registered, exam [Month Year]

thinProof.label: Thin on proof?
thinProof.text: Add one Work Simulation level and the four quick certificates.
thinProof.textNothing: Do one Work Simulation level. It gives you a line you earned, with your own numbers.

unsure.label: Domain not decided?
unsure.text: Start with statutory audit and some tax.

portal: Applying on a firm's portal? Use {design} with the same order.
